doc: Every game system the mashup touches. Rows with a null mechanism are not designed yet (they depend on what the real SM2 files turn out to contain).

rows.name: Start Dark Souls III through ModEngine2
rows.what: Play starts the game with the mashup's own ModEngine2 config, which loads the hook DLL.
rows.mechanism: modengine2_launcher.exe -t ds3 -p <DarkSoulsIII.exe> -c <generated toml> --modengine-dll <modengine2.dll>; the toml lists the hook DLL under external_dlls and the mod folder under mods

rows.name: Back up and verify the real save
rows.what: The player's real save is proven untouched after every session, or restored.
rows.mechanism: sha256 manifest of the real save folder before launch plus a full copy in {data}/backups; after the game exits compare, and restore from the copy if anything differs

rows.name: Private copy of the save
rows.what: The mashup plays its own copy of the player's character, created on first Play.
rows.mechanism: recursive copy (never move) of the real save folder to {data}/save on first Play; later Plays reuse the private copy

rows.name: Send save file access to the private copy
rows.what: Every file operation the game does under its real save folder lands in the private copy instead.
rows.mechanism: inline hooks (MinHook) on kernelbase file APIs rewrite any path under the real save folder to the private copy

rows.name: Keep the game offline
rows.what: The game process cannot reach any non-loopback network address.
rows.mechanism: inline hooks on ws2_32/winhttp/wininet entry points deny every non-loopback destination or host name; a WSAIoctl hook swaps ConnectEx for a guarded version

rows.name: Close the game if the sandbox is not in place
rows.what: If a sandbox hook cannot be installed the game does not run unprotected.
rows.mechanism: any hook installation error is logged and shown in a message box, then the process is terminated

rows.name: Diagnostic logs
rows.what: A plain log shows what the launcher and hooks did, so a failed test can be diagnosed.
rows.mechanism: append-only text files in {data}/logs with counts of redirected paths and denied connections

rows.name: Mark the game window
rows.what: The window title says this is the Ashen Marine offline copy, so screenshots and the player can tell.
rows.mechanism: SetWindowTextW on the game's top-level window once it exists, appending ' - Ashen Marine (offline copy)'

rows.name: Find the player's Space Marine 2
rows.what: The setup step locates the SM2 install itself, because Melty cannot see it.
rows.mechanism: read Steam's registry path, libraryfolders.vdf and appmanifest_2183900.acf to resolve steamapps/common/<installdir>

rows.name: Read SM2 files
rows.what: SM2's own weapon files are read from the player's install, never changed, never uploaded.
rows.mechanism: open each .pak read-only and read entries by name; never write, never launch or hook SM2

rows.name: Convert SM2 content for DS3
rows.what: SM2 sounds, textures, models and numbers become something Dark Souls III can use, in the mashup's private folder.

rows.name: Put the weapons in the player's inventory
rows.what: The chainsword and bolt pistol are in the inventory the first time the private save loads.

rows.name: Weapons look like SM2's
rows.what: The chainsword and bolt pistol show SM2's models and textures in Dark Souls III.

rows.name: Weapons sound like SM2's
rows.what: Swings, hits and shots play SM2's own sounds.
